## Production release guardrail

- [ ] iOS CI passed
- [ ] TestFlight build uploaded
- [ ] Build assigned to `Founder Family QA`
- [ ] Fatima has access
- [ ] `What to Test` notes populated
- [ ] Critical QA completed
- [ ] Known blockers resolved or explicitly accepted

Fatima's QA is a release-process gate, not an unbreakable CI dependency. For an emergency release, the repository owner documents the reason and checks:

- [ ] Owner emergency override documented
